headline: MPS student listing assigns chip-top AMS verification and RNM, wreal and schematic models
fact: An Arizona State University recruiting listing dated June 11 advertised an MPS Analog Mixed Signal Verification Intern role in San Jose for a 20–24 week Summer/Fall 2026 placement. The employer description assigns chip-top verification planning and AMS simulation for full-custom precision analog signal-chain ASICs, behavioral models ranging from RNM and logical models to Verilog-AMS electrical/wreal and schematic models, register and trim-mode debug with analog schematics and post-layout RTL, and regression and infrastructure support. June 11 is the university listing's recruitment date; the listed application deadline was June 19.

sources.title: Arizona State University Career Services: MPS Analog Mixed Signal Verification Intern
sources.summary: University recruiting record begins June 11, 2026 and expires June 19. Its indexed employer description explicitly assigns chip-top AMS, RNM/wreal/schematic models and regression work. The direct page is no longer available when checked.
